title: Reward gain and punishment avoidance reversal learning
description: EEG recordings from participants performing two reversal learning tasks that differ in reinforcer type: monetary reward versus avoidance of an aversive loud white noise burst. In the reward task, positive feedback meant a gain of 10 cents and negative feedback meant no gain. In the punishment task, positive feedback meant the noise burst was successfully avoided and negative feedback meant the noise was delivered. Noise intensity was titrated per participant to match the motivational value of the 10 cent reward.
methods_description: Participants completed a monetary reward reversal learning task and a punishment avoidance reversal learning task with EEG recording. The punishment reinforcer was a white noise burst whose intensity (81, 84, 87 or 90 dB) was titrated for each participant to match the 10 cent reward.
